ac-add-to-playlist: layout-transparent wrapper in the add-to-playlist dialog; children styled (.ac-field__hint status, .ac-add-to-playlist__host, .ac-modal__inline-actions footer)
ac-app--access-denied: page-variant marker on styled #app-content.ac-app; access-denied body is styled .ac-empty-state--page
ac-breadcrumb__item: li flex child of styled .ac-breadcrumb ol (gap + list-style none); --current variant styled
ac-chip__text: label span inside styled .ac-chip; inherits chip font-size
ac-controls-ref: section wrapper inside styled .ac-disclosure__body; children .ac-controls-ref__intro/__list styled
ac-facet-group__extra: caller mount slot inside styled .ac-facet-group__controls (flex column gap)
ac-facet-group__sort: sort-row marker on styled .ac-chip-row (facet group inline controls)
ac-field--full: full-width variant marker on styled .ac-field (block field already spans the form column)
ac-filter-chip--toggle: toggle variant marker on styled button.ac-filter-chip (state via aria-pressed, styled)
ac-get-app__features-block: section wrapper inside styled .ac-get-app-page; children __section-title/__features styled
ac-library-bar__status--muted: explicit neutral-tone marker on styled .ac-library-bar__status (base ink is already --ac-muted)
ac-library-display: display-mode chip-row marker on styled .ac-chip-row (library page)
ac-library-empty: empty-state variant marker on styled .ac-empty--section (children __actions/__btn styled)
ac-library-how: section wrapper inside styled collapsible card; children .ac-steps + .ac-field__hint styled
ac-library-sort: sort chip-row marker on styled .ac-chip-row (library page)
ac-main-content: semantic mirror of #ac-main-content on styled .ac-main (skip-link target; JS queries by id)
ac-nav__item--child: child li marker; styled via .ac-nav__children container + .ac-nav__link--child
ac-now-advanced: section marker on styled .ac-disclosure (Now playing advanced settings)
ac-now-queue__sort: sort chip-row marker on styled .ac-chip-row (Now playing queue section)
ac-now-resume: section marker on styled .ac-now-section (Now playing resume row)
ac-now-status__text: state text span inside styled .ac-now-status (tone via --playing/--paused/--buffering modifiers)
ac-now-time__dur: duration span inside styled .ac-now-time (tabular-nums on parent)
ac-now-time__pos: position span inside styled .ac-now-time (tabular-nums on parent)
ac-settings-library: section wrapper inside settings page; children .ac-field__hint + .ac-btn styled
ac-shortcuts: section wrapper inside styled .ac-disclosure__body; child .ac-shortcuts__list styled
ac-track-list__favorite: favorite-action marker on styled .ac-btn--icon (state via aria-pressed/aria-label)
ac-transfer-mount: JS mount point: app-settings.js clones the server-rendered #ac-transfer-template island into this div
ac-transfer-report: marker on styled .ac-dialog; dialog addressed by #ac-transfer-report id in transfer.js
ac-view-loading: skeleton placeholder container inside #ac-view-root; children .ac-skeleton styled
